hook: Nine people and two dogs were trapped in this house.
narration: Nine people and two dogs were trapped in this beach house, with the surf breaking right under it.
This was Dog Island, Florida, in June of 2012. Waves rolled right through the yard.
Over a house, the pilots can't see below the aircraft, so the flight mechanic at the door calls every move.
Then a rescuer in orange made it onto the deck, [short pause] right at their door.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew flew all nine people and both dogs to Carrabelle Airport.
title: Trapped as the surf hit their house
description:
A family of nine people and two dogs was stranded inside a vacation house on Dog Island, Florida, on June 24, 2012. A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Aviation Training Center Mobile rescued them and flew them to Carrabelle Airport.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Aviation Training Center Mobile, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/317650/dog-island-fla-rescue-family-9
